fields.description: Maximum total file size allowed for uploads in MB (default: 200MB)
fields.label: Max Total Upload Size (MB)

fields.description: Maximum chunk size in MB (default: 4MB). Each chunk cannot exceed this size.
fields.label: Max Chunk Size (MB)

fields.description: Recommended chunk size in MB for clients (default: 2MB). Clients should use this for optimal performance.
fields.label: Default Chunk Size (MB)

fields.description: Upload session expiry time in hours (default: 24 hours). Sessions expire after this time if not completed.
fields.label: Session Expiry (Hours)

fields.description: When enabled, the app is blocked for everyone. Maintenance Message is shown. Use only during planned maintenance or major incidents. Remember to disable when done.
fields.label: Maintenance Mode

fields.description: Lowest Android version allowed. Users below this will be forced to update (non-dismissible). Use semver format e.g. 1.2.3. Leave empty to allow all versions.
fields.label: Min Android Version

fields.description: Current latest Android version in stores. Users below this see an optional update prompt (can skip). Use semver format e.g. 1.2.3. Leave empty to skip optional prompts.
fields.label: Latest Android Version

fields.description: Play Store URL for update button. e.g. https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.example.app
fields.label: Android Store URL

fields.description: Lowest iOS version allowed. Users below this will be forced to update (non-dismissible). Use semver format e.g. 1.2.3. Leave empty to allow all versions.
fields.label: Min iOS Version

fields.description: Current latest iOS version in stores. Users below this see an optional update prompt (can skip). Use semver format e.g. 1.2.3. Leave empty to skip optional prompts.
fields.label: Latest iOS Version

fields.description: App Store URL for update button. e.g. https://apps.apple.com/app/id123456789
fields.label: iOS Store URL

fields.default: A new version is available. Please update to continue.
fields.description: Message shown when user is below Min Version. Customize or leave default.
fields.label: Update Message

fields.default: The app is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
fields.description: Message shown when Maintenance Mode is enabled. Customize or leave default.
fields.label: Maintenance Message
